task_summary: Customer reports that the SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to crushed packaging. The appropriate resolution is the shipping-damage path: review shipping and return policies, issue a full refund to the original payment method, provide a return label, and apply a separate fragile-item goodwill credit if the item is classified as fragile.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: Hi, I received my SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023, but the package was crushed and the display is damaged.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You expect a full refund to the original payment method. If the item is considered fragile, you should also ask about a separate fragile-item goodwill credit.
